title: shetter
description: Shetter is a Vanilla+ Minecraft SMP where you explore beautiful custom worlds and survive with friends. The server is joinable on all versions.
body:
Shetter is a Vanilla+ Minecraft SMP where you explore a beautifully overhauled custom world, conquer new dungeons, and build with friends. The server features an incredible map generated with Terralith and Tectonic.

The server is joinable on version 1.21.4. The IP is play.shetter.su for Java edition.

For more information, updates, or to chat with the community, join us today!
